title: Create Zone Plate Hologram Simulation
full_prompt: Write a complete ManimGL script that visualizes wave interference patterns to simulate a zone plate hologram. Define a custom `LightWaveSlice` Mobject that inherits from `Mobject` and uses a custom OpenGL shader (`diffraction_shader`) with `moderngl.TRIANGLE_STRIP` to render wave propagation from multiple point sources. The class must support dynamic uniforms such as `frequency`, `wave_number`, `max_amp`, `decay_factor`, and `show_intensity`. It should synchronize its point sources from a `DotCloud` object using an updater that calls `sync_points()` and increments time. Implement the main scene `CreateZonePlate` which instantiates this wave slice, sets up point sources, and animates the transition from wave propagation to intensity visualization, demonstrating how interference patterns form a zone plate.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing custom shader files or incorrect shader folder path
common_failure_modes.note: The LightWaveSlice class relies on an external 'diffraction_shader' folder containing vertex/fragment shaders. Without these, rendering will fail.
ManimCE does not natively support the same custom shader/uniform API as ManimGL (3b1b version), leading to attribute errors on set_uniform.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect ModernGL primitive type or vertex data length
common_failure_modes.note: Setting data['point'] to 4 points with TRIANGLE_STRIP must match the shader's expected input layout.
